ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the diagram, in rhombus ABCD, DE $\perp$ AB, $\cos A = \frac{3}{5}$, and BE = 2, then what is the value of $\tan \angle DBE$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Let the side length of rhombus $ABCD$ be $t$.\\
$\because BE = 2$,\\
$\therefore AE = t - 2$.\\
$\therefore \cos A = \frac{3}{5} = \frac{AE}{AD} = \frac{AB - BE}{AD}$,\\
$\therefore \frac{3}{5} = \frac{t - 2}{t}$,\\
$\therefore t = 5$.\\
$\therefore AE = 5 - 2 = 3$.\\
$\therefore DE = \sqrt{AD^2 - AE^2} = \sqrt{5^2 - 3^2} = 4$.\\
$\therefore \tan \angle DBE = \frac{DE}{BE} = \frac{4}{2} = \boxed{2}$.
